ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% high-intensity (white) to 25% low-intensity (black) pixel ratio across the visible ventral surface, characterized by a dominant white field with a thick black perimeter and center line.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity contiguous white regions bifurcated by a vertical low-intensity black band along the median line. Low-intensity black pixels form a continuous border of varying thickness around the entire fluke perimeter, with localized dark speckling visible in the lower interior quadrants of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated acute angle of approximately 45 degrees; notch depth occupies roughly 15% of the total vertical height of the fluke structure.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations detected along the trailing edge. Multiple jagged peaks and valleys with pixel amplitudes ranging from 5 to 20 pixels in height relative to the lobe baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward curvature extending from the median notch, transitioning to a convex outward curve toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular, high-contrast, textured pixel formations localized on the extreme left and right distal tips; secondary clusters visible along the upper trailing edge peaks.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct dark-pixel linear streaks on the right lobe, oriented diagonally (upper-left to lower-right) relative to the fluke orientation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive jagged physical irregularities along the trailing edge boundary; heavy colonization of high-contrast textured masses on the distal extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized high-intensity white pixel bursts (water spray) occluding the lower-right margin of the fluke boundary.
